previous_35_source_measurability: 10/35 source-complete all-native q, 8/35 complete daylength, 7/10 positive and 3/10 negative among source-complete q respondents; nonresponse must stay missing not zero
original_provider_MD5_check: Require the identical original provider bitstream UUID, bytes and MD5 as original pre-event source-file metadata receipt. Verify downloaded original bytes with MD5 before any native GPS event parsing.
all_source_native_q: One original registered native taxon per Wave3 source; no source substitution. From previous RSDS one_taxon: choose max one GPS fix per UTC-hour, adjacent 0.5–2h, same solar daypart/date and plausible <=60 km/h great-circle GPS speed; >=3 DAY and >=3 NIGHT steps per tag solar day, >=10 paired solar days per original tag-year, >=5 original independent tagged individuals for original q and daylength. Keep original equal-tag q estimand and original bootstrap confidence descriptions unchanged.
q_definition: Source-native q is original animal-equal mean of NIGHT minus DAY log1p observed GPS straight-line step speed (not actual duration of nocturnality); q null is not imputed for missing sources.
daylength_definition: Source-native within-original-animal-year q~astronomical-daylength slope; requires original source support; not causal sunlight or measured irradiance.
source_gps_privacy: Any human-sourced identity is immutable no-access HOLD; never download original human files/GPS/animal IDs. Original animal GPS coordinates, original exact dates, tag IDs, tracks or individual effects may not leave ephemeral Actions runner; publish source-only aggregate effects/HOLD.
source_study_unit: Source original repository study ID/DOI, not every GPS fix, original tag, or taxon, is the unit of independent source replication.
sample_inference: Wave3 quota decided after Wave1 and Wave2 outcomes. New actual 16 source identities were fixed via original source-only SHA ranks and metadata before Wave3 first GPS events. Original Movebank metadata priority is not a global probability wildlife sample and includes managed/domestic cohorts unless independently screened blind to results.
